status: offline-compiled HOT receiver connectivity fixture; no firmware, PCB, or bench qualification
scope: Standalone Atopile fixture for Rev31 ATmega328P-AU and ISO7741F receiver pin plan. Adds four 5 V Schmitt output buffers and a HOT rail supervisor on the ISP-compatible reset node. No edits to earlier revision folders or product PCB.

assertions: all 32 ATmega pins appear exactly once in the compiled graph
ISO7741F command, response, permit, and relay channel direction/pin mapping
all four MCU GPIO-to-LVC1G17 inputs are distinct from buffered outputs
HOT rails_ok to TPS3890 MR, TPS3890 RESET to MCU and ISP shared node
compiled BOM MPN identity for MCU, isolator, four output buffers, and reset supervisor

reset.topology: SENSE=HOT_LOGIC5; active-low MR=Rev29 HOT_RAILS_OK; open-drain RESET_N shared with ATmega PC6/RESET and ISP; 10 kohm pullup, 1 Mohm weak pulldown
reset.sink_current_bound: <0.75 mA at 5.5 V using 10 kohm -1%, ATmega internal RESET pullup 30 kohm minimum, and 1 Mohm -1% pulldown; <0.37 mA at 2.7 V
reset.margin: At VCC>=4.5 V, TPS3890 VOL<=0.30 V at 3 mA versus ATmega RESET VIL<=0.1*VCC (0.45 V at 4.5 V), >=0.15 V margin. At VCC=2.7 V, VOL<=0.25 V at 2 mA versus VIL<=0.27 V, 0.02 V margin. RESET high divider bound >=0.989*VCC versus VIH=0.9*VCC, excluding the MCU internal pullup which improves it.
reset.integration_limit: Depends on Rev29 shared HOT_RAILS_OK behavior, threshold tolerance, and release delay. No low-level reset guarantee is claimed below ATmega specified VCC=2.7 V; full startup below that point and BOD fuse programming remain unverified.

logic_levels.mcu_to_buffer: Approximately 60 uA maximum load per MCU output from 100 kohm pulldown at 5.5 V plus TI LVC1G17 input leakage. ATmega VOH and LVC1G17 threshold published points do not form a complete same-corner min/max proof.
logic_levels.buffer_to_rev29: The Rev29 10 kohm pulldowns load each LVC1G17 output by about 0.55 mA at 5.5 V. TI gives VOH>=3.8 V at VCC=4.5 V under a heavier 32 mA load; WDI VIH is 0.8*VDD. The full maximum-rail output-high guarantee at VDD=5.5 V remains open. ARM full-corner receiver threshold also remains open.

limitations: No receiver firmware, framing/CRC/baud definition, persistent session journal, or protocol tests
No prototype, bench measurements, or total shutdown latency bound
ATmega and TPS3890 footprints remain review-only; crystal and assembly BOM are not selected
No full-corner proof for LVC1G17 input/output levels or power-ramp behavior
